hook.say: The giants of the world map, head to head. Which is bigger? Five duels, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is bigger: Canada or USA (lower 48)?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Canada or the lower forty-eight U S states?
questions.fact: Canada is almost a quarter bigger than the lower 48 US states.
questions.sayAnswer: Canada! It is almost a quarter bigger than the lower forty-eight U S states.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Australia or Brazil?
questions.fact: Brazil is about 10% bigger than Australia.
questions.sayAnswer: Brazil! It is about ten percent bigger than Australia.

questions.q: Which is bigger: India or Kazakhstan?
questions.fact: India is about 20% bigger than Kazakhstan.
questions.sayAnswer: India! It is about twenty percent bigger than Kazakhstan.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Algeria or Argentina?
questions.fact: Argentina is about 17% bigger than Algeria, Africa's largest country.
questions.sayAnswer: Argentina! It is about seventeen percent bigger than Algeria, the largest country in Africa.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Australia or USA (lower 48)?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Australia or the lower forty-eight U S states?
questions.fact: The lower 48 US states are only about 4% bigger than Australia.
questions.sayAnswer: The lower forty-eight! They are only about four percent bigger than Australia.
